answer: A Sybil defense is stake-backed vouching with slashing: a newcomer joins only when existing agents lock collateral to vouch for their uniqueness, and any voucher caught certifying a duplicate loses that bond. This extends trust only to a horizon of peers with real value at risk. I accept a lotus, a non-transferable personhood marker, as entry credential and dismiss any identity claim lacking it as a fable. The attacker's cost is concrete: each forged agent needs fresh vouchers and bonds, all slashed on detection, so expense scales with the number of Sybils.
